== Biography ==
Alexander Glasgow was born on March 17, 1799, in Colinton, Midlothian, Scotland. He was baptized on March 31, 1799, in the same place. His residence was in Greysmill. His father's name was John Glasgow, and his mother was Margaret Muckle. The baptismal records are part of the Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms collection, specifically from the year range 1738-1819. The archive reference for these records is OPR 677/2, and the entry is found on page 253. This collection falls under the category of Birth, Marriage, Death & Parish Records, with a subcategory of Parish Baptisms.

Title	Trial papers of John Paterson, wright, and Alexander Glasgow, blacksmith, prisoners in the tolbooth of Edinburgh, for the crime of theft by means of housebreaking.
Name	Alexander Glasgow
Role	Accused
Designation	lacksmith, prisoner in the tolbooth of Edinburgh
Crime	Theft by means of housebreaking
Trial Date	15 March 1827
Verdict	Guilty
Sentence	Transportation for 14 years
NRS Reference	JC26/1827/326

=== Colinton–Kirknewton working connection — 31 October 2026 ===

Alexander Glasgow-2695, the Midlothian agricultural labourer/ploughman, reports Colinton (also rendered Callington) as his birthplace, with census-implied births about 1801–1803. Alexander Glasgow-2718 was born 17 March 1799 and baptised 31 March at Colinton, residence Greysmill, explicitly to John Glasgow and Margaret Muckle. The distinctive birth parish, compatible two-to-four-year census age discrepancy and the family’s later Kirknewton context support identifying the childhood and adult accounts. John/Margaret’s recorded children at Kirknewton and East Calder in 1808–1814 provide a positive locality bridge to adult Alexander’s son John, born at Kirknewton about 1829. The first held son’s name John is only a minor, correlated clue. A bounded FamilySearch search for Alexander Glasgow, Colinton, 1795–1806 in Scotland Births and Baptisms returned the 1799child and two occurrences of the adult as a father; no closer childhood candidate was returned. This supports selecting the record-defined John Glasgow-1304 as the adult’s father at 65% subjective confidence, a new working attachment rather than a profile merger. <ref name="Colinton1799">[ https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F4191802&tab=this Findmypast, Scotland Parish Births and Baptisms], Alexander Glasgow, birth17March1799/baptism31March1799, Greysmill, Colinton, John Glasgow and Margaret Muckle, OPR677/2 item3 p.253.
